name: bee-channel
description: Bee AI wearable as an inbound-only channel: a client-side watcher subscribes to the Bee local proxy's SSE event stream and posts selected events into the ag2space task broker via /v1/ingest (source=bee). Results route to the Bee fallback DM room broker-side (backend#444 asymmetric-channel rule). Config-only manifest — no runtime tools; run scripts/bee_watcher.py as a background process.
